Keys = store domain without www./shop. + '/' + product handle. 'stores_before' = a whole store's listings published before a date (a print-on-demand catalog FYM only carries a selection of); newer listings from that store still count. Read by builder/fym_gate.py [100]; the sweep itself is builder/partner_mat_sweep.py (run by the launch watch).
